title: Elux Legend Blackcurrant Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Blackcurrant Menthol blends the juicy, sweet flavour of ripe Blackcurrants with a brisk, cooling Menthol finish. This e-liquid ensures the perfect balance between sweet and sharp, fruity and fresh, providing a tangy and refreshing vape experience. The rich berry notes of Blackcurrant are enhanced by the cool Menthol, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy a fresh and fruity flavour. Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths, making them ideal for adult ex-smokers or vapers seeking the swift and satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Each flavour is crafted using premium ingredients to ensure a clean and authentic taste with every puff. Nicotine salts in Elux Legend Nic Salts provide a smoother and more immediate form of nicotine relief over traditional freebase nicotine. Nic salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, allowing for quick and efficient nicotine relief without any harshness or throat irritation. Designed for use with pod systems and other low-wattage MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices, Elux Legend Nic Salts provide a more concentrated and flavourful vaping experience. They are the ideal choice for adult vapers seeking a high-quality, smooth, and satisfying nicotine experience coupled with great flavours. Try the Elux Legend Nic Salts line today and experience the next level of vaping satisfaction.
